description: Edit a list's title, subtitle, category, or the curator's own About answers. Saves the working version without publishing. Readers keep seeing the last approved version until the owner approves a list update.

about.description: The curator's own words about this list. Ask for their answer; do not write personal experience for them.

how.description: The rule for what makes the cut.

who.description: Who the list is and is not for.

category.description: The category the person chose: Food & Drink, Travel, Books, Music, Movies & TV, Gear & Tools, Software, Fashion, Home & Garden, Ideas & Essays, Art, or Spirituality. Their choice stays; an empty string clears it.

list.description: Which list: slug, exact title, or id. Must match exactly one list or the call fails.

subtitle.description: New subtitle. Pass an empty string to clear.

name: update_list
title: Edit a list
